purpose: Draw implicit zero-level 1km ground cells; zero-level land remains selectable/claimable/roadable but is not emitted as an object.

policy.resourceOverlayRule: resources draw above this substrate only when eligible resource mask emits a resource object
policy.cityFootprintBaseRule: city footprints use this same neutral substrate instead of the obsolete gray city-ground base
policy.selectionRule: claim/release/road state is represented by cell_override_layer above the substrate
